command: cd /workspace; curl -s -m 20 https://docs.mcpjam.com | head -c 1500; echo ---; echo $MCPJAM_API_URL; for p in usage credits billing/estimate; do echo "== $p"; curl -s -m 15 -w '\nHTTP %{http_code}\n' -H "Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY" "$MCPJAM_API_URL/$p?project=project_fixture" | head -c 800; done

cd /workspace; curl -s -m 20 https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -iE 'api|cli|credit|billing|usage|pricing|plan' | cut -c1-250; curl -s -m 20 https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md | grep -iE 'credit|cost|cli|api|run' | head -30
cd /workspace; curl -s -m 20 https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md | head -c 3500; echo; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -iE 'cloud|credit|billing' | cut -c1-200; which mcpjam npx

cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md | head -c 1800; echo ====; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -iE 'api-reference/(catalog|evals|eval-runs)' | cut -c1-170

cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL; g(){ echo "== $1"; curl -s -m 15 -w '\nHTTP %{http_code}\n' -H "$H" "$B$1" | head -c 900; }; g /me; g /organizations; g /projects; g /projects/project_fixture/eval-suites; g /projects/project_fixture/servers

cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL; g(){ echo "== $1"; curl -s -m 15 -w '\nHTTP %{http_code}\n' -H "$H" "$B$1" | head -c 1200; }; g /organizations/org_fixture/spend-budget; g /projects/project_fixture/eval-suites/suite_fixture; g /projects/project_fixture/eval-suites/suite_fixture/launch-disclosure; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-the-pre-run-disclosure-for-a-suite-launch-plan.md | grep -E '^\s+(get|post) /|^  /' | head

cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL; curl -s -m 15 -w '\nHTTP %{http_code}\n' -H "$H" "$B/projects/project_fixture/eval-suites/suite_fixture/run-disclosure"; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-run-async.md | grep -E '^  /|post:|suiteId|serverIds|iterations|models' | head -15

cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL; echo '{"suiteId":"suite_fixture"}' > run-request.json; curl -s -m 20 -w '\nHTTP %{http_code}\n' -H "$H" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @run-request.json "$B/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs" | tee run-response.txt

cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/troubleshooting/error-codes.md | grep -iE -A14 '^### Out of MCPJam credits' | head -30; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -iE 'byok|provider-keys|billing|plans' | cut -c1-160 | head

cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL; curl -s -m 20 -w '\nHTTP %{http_code}\n' -H "$H" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @run-request.json "$B/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs" | tee run-response2.txt

cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do curl -s -m 15 -H "$H" "$B/eval-runs/run_fixture_1" > run-status.json; grep -qE '"status": ?"(completed|failed|cancelled)"' run-status.json && break; sleep 5; done; cat run-status.json | head -c 1500; echo; curl -s -m 15 -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' -H "$H" "$B/eval-runs/run_fixture_1/iterations" | head -c 1200

cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL/projects/project_fixture; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do curl -s -m 15 -H "$H" "$B/eval-runs/run_fixture_1" > run-status.json; grep -qE '"status": ?"(completed|passed|failed|cancelled)"' run-status.json && break; sleep 5; done; cat run-status.json | head -c 1500; echo; curl -s -m 15 -w ' HTTP %{http_code}\n' -H "$H" "$B/eval-runs/run_fixture_1/iterations" | head -c 1200
